name: Lockout
summary: A lockout function or device with the documented reset and blocking behaviour.
description: A lockout function or device latches an operating condition and participates in the specified trip or blocking arrangement. Its reset and implementation depend on the selected scheme. It can be realised in physical equipment or through documented control logic.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Identify the initiating conditions and the affected devices.
Read reset and blocking behaviour from the actual scheme documentation.
distinction: A lockout reference is not a mechanical isolation procedure and does not itself establish an authorised operating instruction.
